lessonTitle: §1.6 · Từ vector sang ma trận dữ liệu
purpose: Phòng lab deterministic cho data-contract validation, row-observation assembly, extraction/slicing, transpose convention, NumPy shape traps, feature-wise centering, Gram/covariance boundary và semantic code audit.
learningObjectives: Validate shape plus semantic schema before stacking.
Assemble X_raw with observations as rows and keep metadata aligned.
Extract entry/row/column/block with feature and observation identity.
Demonstrate NumPy one-dimensional transpose behavior safely.
Reproduce locked mean and centred matrix with assertions.
Distinguish raw Gram calculations from sample covariance assumptions.
Reject the locked negative variants without numeric guesswork.
Audit shape-correct but semantically invalid code.
Stop at rank/PCA/diagnosis boundaries required by §1.6.

canonicalCode.title: Pipeline chuẩn có assertion
canonicalCode.code:
import numpy as np

FEATURES = [
    'omega_left', 'omega_right', 'a_long',
    'a_lat', 'yaw_rate', 'battery_current'
]
UNITS = ['rad/s', 'rad/s', 'm/s^2', 'm/s^2', 'rad/s', 'A']
OBS_IDS = [f'UGV-W{i:02d}' for i in range(1, 9)]
TIMESTAMPS = [
    '2026-07-09T10:00:00.000Z',
    '2026-07-09T10:00:00.250Z',
    '2026-07-09T10:00:00.500Z',
    '2026-07-09T10:00:00.750Z',
    '2026-07-09T10:00:01.000Z',
    '2026-07-09T10:00:01.250Z',
    '2026-07-09T10:00:01.500Z',
    '2026-07-09T10:00:01.750Z',
]
SCHEMA_VERSION = 'CASE_C01_L06_V1_LOCKED'

rows = [
    [8.2, 8.1, 0.12, 0.03, -0.02, 11.8],
    [8.5, 8.7, 0.18, 0.05,  0.04, 12.1],
    [9.0, 9.4, 0.25, 0.11,  0.08, 12.9],
    [9.3, 9.1, 0.10,-0.04, -0.05, 13.2],
    [8.8, 8.3,-0.08,-0.12, -0.10, 12.4],
    [8.1, 7.9,-0.22,-0.06, -0.04, 11.6],
    [7.7, 8.0,-0.15, 0.08,  0.06, 11.3],
    [8.4, 8.9, 0.05, 0.14,  0.11, 12.0],
]

LOCKED_MU = np.array([8.5, 8.55, 0.03125, 0.02375, 0.01, 12.1625])
LOCKED_XC = np.array([
    [-0.3,-0.45, 0.08875, 0.00625,-0.03,-0.3625],
    [ 0.0, 0.15, 0.14875, 0.02625, 0.03,-0.0625],
    [ 0.5, 0.85, 0.21875, 0.08625, 0.07, 0.7375],
    [ 0.8, 0.55, 0.06875,-0.06375,-0.06, 1.0375],
    [ 0.3,-0.25,-0.11125,-0.14375,-0.11, 0.2375],
    [-0.4,-0.65,-0.25125,-0.08375,-0.05,-0.5625],
    [-0.8,-0.55,-0.18125, 0.05625, 0.05,-0.8625],
    [-0.1, 0.35, 0.01875, 0.11625, 0.10,-0.1625],
], dtype=float)

def validate_contract(rows_value, features, units, obs_ids, timestamps, version):
    if version != SCHEMA_VERSION:
        raise ValueError('schema version mismatch')
    if list(features) != FEATURES:
        raise ValueError('feature order mismatch')
    if list(units) != UNITS:
        raise ValueError('unit contract mismatch')
    if list(obs_ids) != OBS_IDS:
        raise ValueError('observation identity mismatch')
    if list(timestamps) != TIMESTAMPS:
        raise ValueError('timestamp contract mismatch')
    arr = np.asarray(rows_value, dtype=float)
    if arr.shape != (8, 6):
        raise ValueError(f'wrong canonical shape: {arr.shape}')
    return arr

observations = [np.array(row, dtype=float) for row in rows]
X_candidate = np.stack(observations, axis=0)
X_raw = validate_contract(X_candidate, FEATURES, UNITS, OBS_IDS, TIMESTAMPS, SCHEMA_VERSION)
assert X_raw.shape == (8, 6)

assert np.isclose(X_raw[2, 4], 0.08)
assert np.allclose(X_raw[2, :], [9.0, 9.4, 0.25, 0.11, 0.08, 12.9])
assert np.allclose(X_raw[:, 4], [-0.02, 0.04, 0.08, -0.05, -0.10, -0.04, 0.06, 0.11])
assert np.allclose(X_raw[2:5, 2:5], [
    [0.25, 0.11, 0.08],
    [0.10,-0.04,-0.05],
    [-0.08,-0.12,-0.10],
])

X_col = X_raw.T
assert X_col.shape == (6, 8)
assert np.allclose(X_col[:, 2], X_raw[2, :])

x = X_raw[2, :]
assert x.shape == (6,)
assert x.T.shape == (6,)
assert x.reshape(1, 6).shape == (1, 6)
assert x.reshape(6, 1).shape == (6, 1)

e_yaw = np.array([0., 0., 0., 0., 1., 0.])
yaw = X_raw @ e_yaw
assert np.allclose(yaw, X_raw[:, 4])

mu = X_raw.mean(axis=0)
assert np.allclose(mu, LOCKED_MU, atol=1e-12)
X_c = X_raw - mu
assert X_c.shape == (8, 6)
assert np.allclose(X_c, LOCKED_XC, atol=1e-12)
assert np.allclose(X_c.mean(axis=0), np.zeros(6), atol=1e-12)
assert np.allclose(X_c[2, :] + mu, X_raw[2, :], atol=1e-12)

G_f = X_raw.T @ X_raw
G_o = X_raw @ X_raw.T
assert G_f.shape == (6, 6)
assert G_o.shape == (8, 8)

yaw_raw_self_product = float(yaw @ yaw)
yaw_centered = X_c[:, 4]
yaw_sample_variance = float((yaw_centered @ yaw_centered) / (X_c.shape[0] - 1))
assert np.isclose(yaw_raw_self_product, 0.0382, atol=1e-12)
assert np.isclose(yaw_sample_variance, 0.005342857142857143, atol=1e-12)

rank_upper_bound = min(X_raw.shape)
assert rank_upper_bound == 6

print({
    'shape': X_raw.shape,
    'transpose_shape': X_col.shape,
    'mean': mu.tolist(),
    'yaw_raw_self_product': yaw_raw_self_product,
    'yaw_sample_variance': yaw_sample_variance,
    'rank_upper_bound': rank_upper_bound,
})

labSequence.title: Load and validate the locked contract
tasks: Create FEATURES, UNITS, OBS_IDS, TIMESTAMPS and rows exactly as locked.
Assemble the eight observations with np.stack(observations, axis=0) under the row-observation convention.
Validate schema version, feature order, units, observation IDs and timestamps before downstream arithmetic.
Assert final canonical shape 8x6.
State why timestamp remains metadata rather than feature column.
passConditions: Any metadata mismatch raises before downstream arithmetic.

labSequence.title: Extract scalar, row, column and block with metadata
tasks: Assert X_raw[2,4]==0.08 and attach UGV-W03/yaw_rate/rad/s labels.
Recover X_raw[2,:].
Recover X_raw[:,4].
Recover X_raw[2:5,2:5] and the aligned row/feature metadata.

labSequence.title: Translate convention and expose the 1D transpose trap
tasks: Compute X_col=X_raw.T and assert shape 6x8.
Verify UGV-W03 appears as column 2 in X_col.
Show x.shape and x.T.shape are both (6,) for a 1D ndarray.
Create explicit (1,6) and (6,1) views with reshape.
Compare stack(axis=0) versus column_stack outputs without calling either one universally correct.

labSequence.title: Linear selector proves feature-order dependence
tasks: Compute y=X_raw@e_yaw.
Assert y equals X_raw[:,4].
Explain why the same numeric w would select the wrong semantic feature after a silent column permutation.

labSequence.title: Reproduce locked mean and centering
tasks: Compute mu=X_raw.mean(axis=0).
Assert mu equals LOCKED_MU.
Compute X_c=X_raw-mu and assert exact locked shape 8x6.
Assert X_c equals LOCKED_XC within 1e-12.
Assert feature-wise mean of X_c is zero within tolerance.
Reconstruct UGV-W03 from X_c[2,:]+mu.

labSequence.title: Gram shapes and covariance boundary
tasks: Compute G_f=X_raw.T@X_raw and G_o=X_raw@X_raw.T.
Assert shapes 6x6 and 8x8.
Compute raw yaw self-product and centered sample variance.
Explain why 0.0382 and 0.005342857142857143 answer different questions.
Do not eigendecompose covariance or interpret PCA components.

labSequence.title: Reject the four locked invalid variants
tasks: Construct a metadata variant with swapped wheel feature order and expect rejection.
Construct stale-unit metadata for omega_left rpm with rad/s label and expect rejection.
Pass X_raw.T under canonical validator and expect shape rejection.
Pass a schema-version mismatch and expect rejection.
passConditions: All four invalid variants fail loudly.
No transpose or relabeling silently normalizes bad input.
The canonical locked case still passes.

labSequence.title: Audit downstream boundaries before handing off
tasks: Record scale vector as unlocked rather than fabricate X_s.
For symbolic A in R^(6xp), state Y=XA has shape 8xp and requires input feature-order compatibility.
Compute only rank upper bound min(8,6)=6.
List missing ingredients before PCA component/retained-dimension claims.
State that contract/data-quality failures are not physical fault diagnosis.

brokenCodeAudits.title: Transpose until multiplication runs
brokenCodeAudits.badCode: X = X.T  # because downstream shape failed
brokenCodeAudits.whyWrong: It changes observation/feature convention without translating metadata or formulas.
brokenCodeAudits.repair: Fix the upstream orientation contract; if converting conventions intentionally, rename to X_col and rewrite interpretation.

brokenCodeAudits.title: Assume x.T creates a row matrix
brokenCodeAudits.whyWrong: For a one-dimensional ndarray, .T keeps shape (6,).
brokenCodeAudits.repair: Use x.reshape(1,6) for explicit row or x.reshape(6,1) for explicit column.

brokenCodeAudits.title: Stack equal-length vectors without schema checks
brokenCodeAudits.whyWrong: NumPy can stack shape-compatible rows even if units, order or schema version differ.
brokenCodeAudits.repair: Validate semantic contract first, then call vstack/stack(axis=0).

brokenCodeAudits.title: Treat raw Gram as covariance
brokenCodeAudits.whyWrong: Raw Gram lacks centering and the declared covariance normalization; mixed units further limit interpretation.
brokenCodeAudits.repair: Use covariance formula only under declared row-observation, centering and divisor assumptions.

brokenCodeAudits.title: Refit preprocessing on every live batch
brokenCodeAudits.whyWrong: It silently changes the reference interface and can introduce leakage/drift relative to a fitted downstream model.
brokenCodeAudits.repair: Reuse the declared reference/training mean and scale parameters when the model contract requires them.

brokenCodeAudits.title: Turn data-contract failure into a fault diagnosis
brokenCodeAudits.whyWrong: Schema/data-quality evidence does not identify a physical cause.
brokenCodeAudits.repair: Raise a data-contract error; diagnostic inference requires a separate validated model and evidence.
